name: @epoch/solution-delivery
description: Epoch Solution Delivery kernel (W036) — the universal delivery DOMAIN MODEL (USL1.0, binding): tenant-scoped SolutionPackage + immutable hash-chained SolutionVersion baselines; DeliveryRecord delivery-facts authority (observation intake, acceptance, actualization of ACCEPTED observations only); ProgramOfWork authoritative schedule dimension (dependency-aware realization graph with deterministic quantity/cost/resource folds); the universal Understand/Decide/Plan/Acquire/Realize/Observe/Actualize/Verify/Forecast/Close/Learn lifecycle as typed stage records + typed relations (branch/pause/resume/loop/overlap — projections, never a linear FSM); the nine semantic-distinction record types (Prediction/Estimate/Baseline/Commitment/Observation/Actual/Forecast/Outcome/LearningRecord — immutable, digest-bearing, never collapsed); uncertainty/provenance/freshness/confidence on facts; information-acquisition requests; provider-neutral acquisition/realization variant catalogs and external request/event envelopes; the delivery:* event vocabulary over the W010 event shapes; and Solution Navigator synchronized projections over the SAME identities. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary.
